name: Luis Arias
tagline: Strategy & Operations | Marketplace Growth | Travel & Fintech

about.title: About Me
about.description: Strategy and operations leader building and scaling tech-enabled products and marketplaces across mobility, travel, and payments.
paragraphs: I enjoy turning complex problems into clear strategies and working with cross-functional teams to launch initiatives that drive growth and improve customer experience.
Outside of work I enjoy hiking, long walks with my dog, reading, traveling, and experimenting in the kitchen.

items.title: Scaling Global Marketplace Initiatives
items.description: Led cross-functional strategy and operations initiatives across global teams at Uber and Booking.com, driving marketplace growth across travel and mobility verticals including flights, car rentals, and payments integrations.

items.title: Marketplace Supply & Unit Economics Analysis
items.description: Built supply health frameworks analyzing churn, vehicle activation cohorts, and 12-month lifetime value (LTV) to identify supply gaps and inform host acquisition incentives and marketplace expansion strategies.

items.title: Customer Service Strategy Transformation
items.description: Developed a forward-looking customer service strategy focused on benchmarking service standards, optimizing process flows, and designing differentiated support experiences across customer segments and channels.

items.title: EU Premium Market Trade Strategy
items.description: Advised export organizations and producer groups on how to move beyond commodity positioning in EU markets by defining differentiation pathways, credible sustainability narratives, and clearer buyer-facing messaging.

projects.title: Luis Arias Consulting B.V.
projects.description: A strategy and trade consulting practice focused on helping export organizations, producer groups, and trade promotion programs strengthen their positioning in EU and premium markets. Work typically combines market analysis, differentiation strategy, and practical buyer-facing messaging—helping suppliers move beyond commodity positioning and engage higher-value buyers with credible, differentiated offerings.

projects.title: Premium & Sustainable Buyer Enablement (VPSA / SIPPO)
projects.description: Developed educational content and strategic guidance for export stakeholders including the Vietnam Pepper and Spice Association (VPSA) and the Swiss Import Promotion Programme (SIPPO), helping producers understand how premium EU buyers evaluate suppliers and how to communicate differentiation beyond generic quality claims.

projects.title: Cocoa & Walnut Differentiation Deep Dive (IPD / ISM Cologne)
projects.description: Prepared a strategic deep dive on cocoa and walnuts supporting Import Promotion Desk (IPD) ahead of ISM Cologne. The work helped suppliers understand what differentiation truly means in EU premium markets and prioritize concrete steps to move away from commodity positioning.

projects.title: US Car Rentals Growth Strategy
projects.description: Developed a strategic assessment identifying key barriers to growth, unmet customer needs, and priority initiatives for expanding the US car rentals marketplace.
